name: Captep AI Writer
author: A. Gobinath

sections.description:
Captep AI Writer adds one Captep AI Writer menu to wp-admin.

  • Connect an OpenAI or Claude API key. Claude uses Sonnet. The key is encrypted in the database.
  • Search pages and posts by title and year, pick one paragraph, and preview that paragraph before anything is saved.
  • Create a new page or blog post from a prompt and optional source text. New items are drafts unless you choose Publish.

A Cursor subscription cannot be connected. Cursor does not provide a content API for this plugin.

Each generation sends the prompt and the selected page text to the provider you choose, and uses that provider’s paid credits. Nothing is sent until you click Test connection, Create previews, or Generate.

External services

This plugin calls only the provider you select, and only after you click a button.

OpenAI

  • Service: https://api.openai.com
  • Sent: your API key, the model id, your prompt, optional notes, and the current title and body of a selected page or post.
  • When: Test connection, Create previews, and Generate.
  • Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
  • Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Anthropic

  • Service: https://api.anthropic.com
  • Sent: your API key, the model id, your prompt, optional notes, and the current title and body of a selected page or post.
  • When: Test connection, Create previews, and Generate.
  • Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms
  • Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In wp-admin, open Plugins, Add New Plugin, and Upload Plugin.
  2. Choose the captep-ai-writer.zip file and click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open Captep AI Writer, then Connect.
  4. Choose OpenAI or Claude, paste the API key, and click Save.
  5. Click Test connection.
  6. Use Update to revise existing pages, or Create to add a new draft.
sections.faq:
Can I sign in with Cursor, ChatGPT, or Claude?

Use an API key from OpenAI or Claude. Those are separate accounts from a Cursor subscription and from the ChatGPT or Claude apps.

Can an update change only one paragraph?

Yes. On Update, pick the page and then the paragraph. Confirming the preview replaces that paragraph and leaves the rest of the page as it is. Choose Entire page only when you want the whole page rewritten.

Will an update replace the live page immediately?

The plugin shows a preview first. The page changes when you click Update this page. WordPress keeps the previous version in revisions when revisions are enabled.

Are new pages published immediately?

Only if you choose Published. The default is Draft.
sections.changelog:
1.3.3

  • All code now uses the unique captaiwr prefix (classes, constants, options, table, AJAX actions, nonces, transients).
  • Every request field is sanitized when it is read, and internal links sent from the browser are validated.
  • Database queries use prepared statements.

1.3.2

  • Removed duplicate Plugin URI so it no longer matches Author URI.

1.3.1

  • Ownership metadata, contributor list, and provider docs cleaned up for WordPress.org review.

1.3.0

  • Write Blog builds a full article section by section, shows an AI-call estimate, and supports refine comments, SEO checks, internal links, and OpenAI images.
  • Tabs renamed to Write Blog, Edit Existing, and Generations.
  • Generations history supports revert and clear.
  • Fresh teal studio UI.

1.2.7

  • Plugin folder, text domain, and admin slug are now captep-ai-writer to match WordPress.org.

1.2.6

  • “Change the title and add an FAQ at the bottom” keeps the current article, updates the title, and adds the FAQ. It no longer replaces the post with the FAQ alone.
  • Selected paragraph still changes only that paragraph.

1.2.5

  • Bold, italic, links, and numbered lists are saved as formatted text. Asterisks such as ** are no longer left in the post.

1.2.4

  • Generate preview asks Claude in short sections, shows each selected post in the preview, and adds an Update button on each one.

1.2.3

  • A long article, including a requested word count, is shown in the preview instead of being discarded.

1.2.2

  • Connect shows OpenAI and Claude only. Claude always uses Sonnet.
  • A connected key can be edited or removed.

1.2.1

  • Connect shows OpenAI and Claude only. Claude always uses Sonnet, so there is no model menu.

1.2.0

  • Previews update the paragraph you select, and the rest of the page stays unchanged.
  • Free-tier models can generate the preview.
  • A preview that the host cuts off now explains what to change instead of failing silently.

1.1.0

  • New guided layout with animated previews and a confirmation step before anything is saved.

1.0.0

  • First release.
